english.title: Vehicle - trade licence holder fail to notify change of business name / address

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES REGISTRATION AND LICENSING REGULATIONS 2002

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a motor vehicle trade licence, following a change in the

(A)_[name]_
(B)_[address]_
(C)_[name and address]_

of your business, failed forthwith to notify the Secretary of State of the change and of the new

(D)_[name]_
(E)_[address]_
(F)_[name and address]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 19 of the Road Vehicles (Registration and Licensing) Regulations 2002 and section 59(1) and (2)(a) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.

english.notes: (i) This offence document replaces RV02006 from 1st October 2014. For any offences of this nature committed before this date, RV02006 should be used (H4926).
